title: "Triple Gambit"
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the three parties were locked in a standoff, a jet-black fissure tore open across the heavens. The familiar summoning aura of the Demonic Path commander descended once more, pushing this contest into an even more perilous four-way confrontation."

text.content: "The celestial void, a vast and boundless sea of stars, slowly circulated beneath Chen Ji's feet. That projection of fate had been seared into his divine soul like a brand—the truth of the Chen bloodline weighed heavily on his heart. They had never been a random occurrence in heaven and earth, but pieces deliberately positioned by some higher dimension."

dialogue.content: "『Chen Ji, you finally know.』 The voice carried no temperature, yet it reached the deepest part of his Dao heart. 『You thought obtaining the Tianji Record was a fortunate coincidence? You thought every choice you made was free will? How可笑.』"

text.content: "Before the words faded, a golden fissure suddenly tore open in the depths of the void. A figure clad in the radiance of sun, moon, and stars stepped forth. Each step triggered resonance with the laws of heaven's way, the pressure toppling like a mountain. Su Qingyao's warning still echoed—the Heavenly Fate emissary had indeed arrived."

dialogue.content: "『Remnants of the old heaven's way,』 the Heavenly Fate emissary's voice rang like metal and stone, 『you have interfered with the mortal realm far too much. This piece was personally chosen by the highest will of the heavenly way—not something your wheezing remnants dare covet.』"

text.content: "Chen Ji listened quietly, but his fists had long since clenched tight. Rage surged through his veins like magma—his life had been arranged from birth, the Chen family's fate never in their own hands. Was his sister being taken by the Holy Sect also part of this chess game?"

dialogue.content: "『Done speaking?』 Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, even a smile tugging at his lips. 『I thought the Heavenly Fate emissary would be more sophisticated. Turns out you're just a dog wagging its tail for its master.』"

text.content: "The air instantly froze. The Heavenly Fate emissary's aura erupted violently; golden divine light transformed into tangible heavenly shackles, spreading toward Chen Ji's surroundings. The representative of the imperial court watched coldly from a distance, seemingly waiting for the right moment."

dialogue.content: "『Interesting.』 That voice carried a playful note. 『This child has more spine than I expected. However, emissary, I suggest you retract your pressure. If something happens to him, the karmic backlash of the Tianji Record is something neither of us can endure.』"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt the pressure on his body suddenly ease, yet his vigilance only sharpened. Three factions, each with treacherous intentions. The remnants of the old heaven's way needed him to bear the Tianji Record, the imperial court wanted the resources in his hands, the Heavenly Fate emissary wanted him obediently obedient as a piece. Not one faction truly stood for him."

dialogue.content: "『Since everyone is here, let's make things clear.』 Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze sweeping across the three factions. 『Fight or talk—make your move. Chen Ji will see this through today.』"

choice.prompt: "The three factions each harbored their own schemes. How should Chen Ji navigate this complex situation?"

choices.description: "Exploit the contradictions between the old heaven's way remnants and the Heavenly Fate emissary, seeking maximum benefit in the gaps between them"
choices.visible_cost: "Making deals with the tiger carries extremely high risk"
choices.risk_hint: "Once exposed, will have offended both factions simultaneously"
choices.process_label: 在两虎相争中寻找机会

text.content: "Chen Ji smiled faintly, turning to the Heavenly Fate emissary: 『The honored one is right, the remnants of the old heaven's way are indeed despicable. However—』 His tone shifted abruptly. 『Rather than settling old scores, I'd rather know what role the highest heavens have arranged for Chen Ji.』"

dialogue.content: "『Clever.』 That voice carried a note of approval. 『You'd better ask me than him. The truth the Heavenly Fate emissary won't tell you, I can.』"

choices.description: "Maintain a neutral stance, refrain from hasty commitments, preserve strength and await the opportune moment"
choices.risk_hint: "May face joint pressure from all three factions"

text.content: "Chen Ji stepped back, his expression indifferent: 『I don't wish to involve myself in your affairs. The Tianji Record is in my hands—whether to use it and how, is my own concern.』"

dialogue.content: "『Standing apart?』 The Heavenly Fate emissary coldly smirked. 『You think you have such qualification? The fate of the Tianji Record bearer was never in your own hands.』"

choices.description: "Defy conventional tactics, directly challenge the rules of the game, expose the weaknesses of all three factions"
choices.visible_reward: "May break the deadlock and seize initiative"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the void: 『Triple gambit? Interesting. But has it ever crossed your minds—if I die here today, the karmic backlash of the Tianji Record, who among you present could endure it?』"

dialogue.content: "The void fell into deathly silence. That voice finally showed emotional fluctuation: 『Are you threatening us?』"

text.content: "Chen Ji offered no answer, only slowly drawing the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. Golden light erupted, an indescribable great Dao pressure swept across all directions. Representatives of all three factions changed color simultaneously—this was the true power of the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: "『You're mad!』 The Heavenly Fate emissary lost composure for the first time; cracks appeared on the golden battle armor. 『Invoking the full power of the Tianji Record, you will die! The entire celestial realm will be buried with you!』"

text.content: "『Death?』 Chen Ji's voice was calm and ice-cold. 『I was born your piece—what meaning does living hold? I might as well destroy the entire chessboard.』 He raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade. 『You forced this upon me.』"

dialogue.content: "『Enough!』 That voice finally turned serious. 『We can negotiate. What do you want?』"

choice.prompt: "The three factions finally showed a compromising stance. What terms should Chen Ji propose?"

choices.description: "Require the heavenly way to reveal the complete truth of the Chen bloodline, as well as his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts"
choices.visible_cost: "Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial information, may unlock new abilities"
choices.risk_hint: "The truth may be crueler than imagined"
choices.process_label: 以天机录为筹码换取真相

text.content: "『The truth.』 Chen Ji's voice was resolute. 『Why my Chen family was born, where my sister Chen Nian is now, and where the complete form of the Tianji Record lies. Answer me, or we go down together.』"

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Fate emissary and that voice exchanged a glance. Finally, that voice sighed: 『Very well, there's no harm telling you. Your sister Chen Nian is the key to unlocking the ultimate seal. And you—are the opposite of that key, the twin of fate.』"

choices.description: "Require the three factions to never interfere with his choices, granting him true autonomy"
choices.visible_reward: "If successful, will completely break the chess game"
choices.risk_hint: "The three factions may agree superficially while scheming secretly"
choices.process_label: 争取话语权，打破被操控的命运

text.content: "『I want freedom.』 Chen Ji spoke each word with emphasis. 『From now on, my fate is my own to decide. You may offer suggestions, but the right to decide lies with me. All three factions sign a heavenly way contract—if violated, heavenly way backlash.』"

dialogue.content: "『You dare make such a demand?』 The Heavenly Fate emissary narrowed his eyes. 『This means our布局 spanning millennia will come to naught.』"

choices.description: "Require each of the three factions to hand over a top-tier cultivation technique or resource to rapidly enhance strength"

text.content: "『The truth can be given gradually.』 Chen Ji收起Tianji Record, his tone serene. 『Let's start with something practical. Each of the three factions shows some sincerity—a cultivation technique, resources, or intelligence, your choice. This isn't excessive, is it?』"

dialogue.content: "『What an appetite.』 That voice harrumphed coldly. 『But compared to the Tianji Record going out of control, that price is indeed worth paying.』"

text.content: "Just as the three factions were about to reach some kind of understanding, an eerie fluctuation suddenly emanated from the depths of the void. Chen Ji's heart tensed—a summoning aura from the Demonic Path commander! And it was more intense and urgent than last time, as if something of extreme urgency was at hand."

dialogue.content: "『The Demonic Path's aura?』 The Heavenly Fate emissary's gaze turned icy cold, fixed upon Chen Ji. 『You have ties with the Demonic Path Holy Sect? This falls outside our agreement.』 That voice also darkened: 『Saintess Ye Qing? Interesting—this chess game grows ever more complex.』"

text.content: "Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. Was the Demonic Path commander's summoning at this critical juncture a coincidence or a scheme? The demonic mist from Ye Qing's side could conceal the Tianji Record's aura—if the three factions discovered their cooperative relationship... his trump cards would be largely exposed."

choice.prompt: "The Demonic Path summoning suddenly descends. The triple gambit is about to become a four-way confrontation. How should Chen Ji respond?"

choices.description: "Meet the Demonic Path commander openly, demonstrating a transcendent status, allowing the three factions to reassess his value"
choices.visible_reward: "The Demonic Path becomes a new backing, gaining more leverage"
choices.risk_hint: "May be jointly executed by all three factions"
choices.process_label: 以魔道为突破口，打破僵局

text.content: "Chen Ji glanced at the three factions and said calmly: 『When the Demonic Path commander invites me, how can Chen Ji refuse? If the honored ones have sincerity, let's discuss again another day.』 With that, his form flickered, about to vanish into the demonic energy."

dialogue.content: "『Stop!』 The Heavenly Fate emissary bellowed. 『Consorting with the Demonic Path—this means making enemies of the entire heavenly way!』"

choices.description: "Use the need to handle heavenly way affairs as a reason to postpone the Demonic Path summoning, maintaining relations with the three factions"
choices.visible_reward: "Consolidate negotiating position with the three factions"
choices.risk_hint: "The Demonic Path may bear a grudge"

text.content: "Chen Ji slightly furrowed his brow, ignoring the demonic energy: 『The Demonic Path's affairs are not urgent. The honored ones haven't given me an answer yet.』 He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his posture composed. 『Or are the three of you planning to let Chen Ji leave before negotiations conclude?』"

dialogue.content: "『You—』 The Heavenly Fate emissary was left speechless. If Chen Ji were allowed to leave now, wouldn't the earlier compromises become a joke? But forcibly detaining him risked truly provoking this madman."

choices.description: "In front of the three factions, probe the content of the Demonic Path summoning, seize the opportunity to gain more intelligence while showcasing his importance"
choices.visible_cost: "Expose the relationship with the Demonic Path"
choices.visible_reward: "The three factions will be even more wary of his value"

text.content: "Rather than avoiding it, Chen Ji walked toward the demonic energy, then turned back to look at the three factions: 『Do you want to know why the Demonic Path commander summoned me? Why not listen together?』 A playful smile curved his lips. 『Perhaps it may benefit you all as well.』"

dialogue.content: "The three factions froze simultaneously. They exchanged glances, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to be so bold. Was this showing off, or something else entirely?"

"『Forget it.』 Chen Ji suddenly stopped, turning to face the Heavenly Fate emissary directly. 『The Demonic Path's affairs can wait. But before that, I want to ask the emissary one question—if I refuse to be your piece today, what will the highest heaven's way do to me?』"

text.content: "The question was too direct. Tension permeated the air. The Heavenly Fate emissary's expression shifted between阴晴不定, and that voice fell silent as well. The imperial court representative watched this scene with keen interest, as if enjoying a fine drama."

dialogue.content: "『You will die.』 The Heavenly Fate emissary finally spoke, his voice ice-cold. 『The Tianji Record will choose the next bearer. And your name, Chen Ji, will be completely erased from the records of the heavenly way. That is the fate of those who defy the heavenly way.』"

text.content: "After hearing this, Chen Ji反而laughed. That smile carried三分mockery,三分rage,还有四分resolution. He slowly spoke, each word seeming to be挤出from between his teeth: 『I was born your piece from the start—what do I fear death? However—』 His tone shifted. 『Are you truly certain you can afford the price of killing me?』 The Tianji Record in his arms burned faintly hot, as if responding to its master's determination."
